items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I never really knew her. I never really knew her.

ctx.x: Yes, she had the talking record that she had.

Alberta came here with me. Alberta. I sent a letter from Alberta. She's back in New York. I never really knew her. I never really knew her. Well, she was on her way to Denver when she stopped here. I never really knew her. Well, she was a cargoer, and I sent her away from me to New York, because she went on the show.
That's where I first saw her. It was in about 1940 in New York.
